list.name: game_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY game_id

list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY environment

list.name: build_version
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY build_version

list.name: source_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_type FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY source_type

targets.rawSql: SELECT JSONExtractString(properties,'enemy') AS enemy, event_name, count() AS actions FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name IN ('enemy_action','enemy_waited')) GROUP BY enemy, event_name LIMIT 1000

SELECT JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') AS outcome, count() AS failures FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='simulation_completed' AND JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') IN ('softlock','invalid_action','timeout')) GROUP BY outcome LIMIT 1000

SELECT avg(JSONExtractFloat(properties,'evaluation_us')) AS mean_us, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractFloat(properties,'evaluation_us')) AS p95_us FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='enemy_action') LIMIT 1000
